question: The government of which of the following states created a draft policy in 2022 for senior citizens on the basis of article 41, which aims to form a directorate for the welfare of senior citizens?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Tamil Nadu government created a draft policy for senior citizens** in 2022 based on Article 41 of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The** policy aims to improve the lives of senior citizens in the state by empowering them**.
 
• **Intergenerational bonding**
 
 
• The policy aims to promote intergenerational bonding between students and elders by adopting old age homes and conducting programs in educational institutions, corporate organizations, and government institutions.
 
 
 
• **Awareness and education**
 
 
• The policy aims to uplift the quality of life of senior citizens through awareness and education.
 
 
 
• **Recognizing senior citizens**
 
 
• The policy aims to recognize the contributions of senior citizens by observing international days for senior citizens.
 
 
 
• The policy was created by the Social Welfare & Women Empowerment Department of the Government of Tamil Nadu.
